Device Object for CIP Axis Capture Motion fault using correct CIP Axis tag. Fixed help text to reflect correct error code. MSF will execute even when axis is faulted. ============================================================ Instruction Overview: ----- Device object of a CIP Axis
Instruction Execution: ----- Edge
Supplemental Descriptions: ----- -Fault_ID: Indicates the BIT of the FIRST FAULT found Fault ID Convertion: Value Error Description 0 No errors present 1-199: Copy of Internal MSO.ERR, MSF.ERR, MAFR.ERR, MASR.ERR (see also EXERR) 200+Bit number: Axis Fault - FLT Sxx - Axis. CIPAxisFaults.xx 400+Bit number: Axis Fault - FLT Mxx - Axis.CIPAxisFaultsRA.xx 500+Bit number: Axis Fault - NODE FLT xx - Axis.ModuleFaults.xx 600+Bit number: Axis Fault - INIT FLT Sxx - Axis.CIPInitializationFaults.xx 700+Bit number: Axis Fault - INIT FLT Mxx - Axis.CIPInitializationFaultsRA.xx 800+Bit number: Axis Fault - SAFE FLT Sxx - Axis.AxisSafetyFaults.xx 900+Bit number: Axis Fault - SAFE FLT Mxx - Axis.AxisSafetyFaultsRA.xx 1000+Bit number: Axis Fault - SAFE FLT xx - Axis.GuardFaults.xx 1100+Bit number: Motion Fault - Axis.MotionFaultStatus.xx 1200+Bit number: APR fault - Axis.CIPAPRFaults.xx 1300+Bit number: APR fault - Axis.CIPAPRFaultsRA.xx
Sts_EXERR Enumeration: Copy of internal MSO.EXERR, MSF. EXERR, MAFR. EXERR, MASR. EXERR
----- -AlarmID: Indicates the BIT of the FIRST ALARM found
Alarm ID convention: 1400+Bit number: Axis Alarm - FLT Sxx - Axis. CIPAxisAlarms.xx 1600+Bit number: Axis Alarm - FLT Mxx - Axis.CIPAxisAlarmsRA.xx 1700+Bit number: Axis Alarm - NODE FLT xx - Axis.ModuleAlarmStatus.xx 1800+Bit number: Axis Alarm - SAFE FLT Sxx - Axis.AxisSafetyAlarms.xx 1900+Bit number: Axis Alarm - SAFE FLT Mxx - Axis.AxisSafetyAlarmsRA.xx 2000+Bit number: Motion Alarm - Axis.MotionAlarmStatus.xx 2100+Bit number: Axis Alarm - INHIBIT Sxx - Axis.CIPStartInhibits.xx 2200+Bit number: Axis.Alarm - INHIBIT Mxx - Axis.CIPStartInhibitsRA.xx
Revision Notes: -----
4.0 - Renamed Add-On Instruction. Support for Device Handler 4.0 1.0 - First Release
